preconditions.description: The length of s_1 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The length of s_2 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The length of virus is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_1)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_1 are uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_2)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_2 are uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in virus)
preconditions.description: All characters in virus are uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The return value is a subsequence of both s_1 and s_2.
The return value does not contain virus as a substring.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in return_value) or return_value == '0'
postconditions.description: The return value consists of uppercase English letters or is '0'.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(lcs) for lcs in lcss if virus not in lcs) or return_value == '0'
postconditions.description: The return value is the longest common subsequence of s_1 and s_2 that does not contain virus as a substring, or '0' if no such subsequence exists.
